shell_commands:
git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(tools): validate tool input against inputSchema in execute

- Add input validation in ToolRegistry.execute before invoking executor
- Return ToolResponse with validation error instead of calling executor
- Cache compiled validators for function-valued schemas using WeakMap
- Format validation errors to include field names and type information
- Add unit test for required field validation

Validates input against the registered JSON Schema to prevent malformed
tool calls from reaching executors. Rejections are returned as
ToolResponse so the model can correct the call within the existing
tool-round budget.
EOF
)"

git commit --amend --no-edit -m "$(git log -1 --pretty=%B)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"

git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs(tools): add spec reference to execute method

Add one-line doc comment to ToolRegistry.execute pointing to the spec
document describing the validation contract.

Update .lore/dod.md to mark facet 2 and 3 as complete.
EOF
)"

git commit --amend --no-edit -m "$(git log -1 --pretty=%B)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
